data.text: Boxing converts a value type to a reference type (object). Unboxing extracts the value type from the object. Both have performance overhead.
Boxing wraps a value type in an object on the heap. Unboxing extracts the value type back. Both involve memory allocation and type checking. Avoid by using generics.
